claim: spec/map/test_context_resolver.md, S1c Given: "the Builder component present in module.json but absent from the journal." This directly contradicts the same leaf's Setup: "Fixture journal: an added event for each component with a task_created receipt (Parser -> task abc-123, added at git_head beef0001)" — Setup requires every component, Builder included, to carry an added journal line.
authoritative_source: The leaf's own Setup section, which is unconditional ("an added event for each component") and is what the shared fixture in context_resolver_test.go must satisfy for every scenario, not just S1c.
evidence: Setup and S1c's Given cannot both hold for one shared fixture: Setup puts an added event on Builder's identity hash, ffeeddccbbaa; S1c's Given says that hash is absent from the journal entirely. The two scenarios that read the fixture (S1c and, structurally, any later scenario) need a single fixture, so one of the two statements in this leaf must be wrong. Per review on PR #251, the fixture now follows Setup (Builder gets an added event, e2, with no task_created receipt naming it) — this still exercises S1c's named branch (latestTaskBearingBracket returning ok=false with a non-empty changeEvents), but S1c's Given text no longer matches the fixture it describes.
proposed_fix: Reword S1c's Given to match Setup, e.g. "the Builder component present in module.json, added in the journal (event e2) but never named by a task_created receipt."
